text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Missing out on victory in the Satsuki Sho, 
the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown. 
A rare flash of frustration shows on Seiun 
Sky's face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) 
will likely be even tougher. Her fellow 
rival, Special Week, is burning with 
passion, calling Derby victory her 
ultimate dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Seiun Sky receives a call 
from her grandfather praising her great 
effort. Her success in the Classic class 
is also her grandfather's dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, without feeling pressured, she 
stayed true to herself. She headed toward 
the second leg of the Triple Crown, the 
Japanese Derby.
